name: ui-apexpages-knowledge-article-controller-record-runtime

evidence.notes: The controller accepts a real Knowledge__kav record with a nondefault Title.
getRecord returns the same metadata-backed Knowledge__kav record and preserves its Title.

source.content: Knowledge__kav article = new Knowledge__kav(Title = 'Local article'); ApexPages.KnowledgeArticleVersionStandardController controller = new ApexPages.KnowledgeArticleVersionStandardController(article); SObject roundTrip = controller.getRecord(); System.assertEquals(article, roundTrip); System.assertEquals('Local article', ((Knowledge__kav)roundTrip).Title);

args: Knowledge__kav article = new Knowledge__kav(Title = 'Local article'); ApexPages.KnowledgeArticleVersionStandardController controller = new ApexPages.KnowledgeArticleVersionStandardController(article); SObject roundTrip = controller.getRecord(); System.assertEquals(article, roundTrip); System.assertEquals('Local article', ((Knowledge__kav)roundTrip).Title);

salesforceExclusionReason: This local fixture proves controller record round-trip against synthetic Knowledge__kav metadata and makes no hosted Knowledge runtime claim.
